title: 全球PUBG强队集结PNC2026首尔总决赛，PCL蓄力冲顶历史佳绩
text:
群雄逐鹿，谁将登顶？6月26日 – 6月28日，全球热门战术竞技游戏PUBG PNC 2026全明星赛总决赛在韩国首尔正式开打！来自全球各地各大顶级战队中的众多全明星选手，在六天的激烈角逐中，为自己的赛区荣耀而战！
本次代表PCL赛区参赛的PNC全明星选手分别为4AM-SpaceMan、17战队-xwudd、17战队-tiantian以及17战队-Lilghost，带队教练是来自17战队的Akuma。对于PCL赛区来说，过去的PNC 2025具有着里程碑的意义。由Aixleft、MMing、Lilghost、Xwudd组成的战队，最终以155分的成绩获得亚军，创造了PCL赛区在PNC赛事中的历史最佳战绩。相信这一次由这4人组成的战队，也定能在PNC的舞台上稳步前进，再次创造新的神话。
一、PNC 2026赛程信息
本届PNC 2026全明星赛采用全新的赛制架构，分为生存赛和总决赛两个阶段，确保每一支队伍都能在公平的环境下展现最强实力。
生存赛：突围之战
时间：6月23日（周二）- 6月24日（周三），每日北京时间18:00开赛
场地：PUBG Seongsu
赛制：每日5场比赛，共10场对决
突围战中，总计16支战队参赛，分别为PNC 2025的后12名：日本、中国台北、菲律宾、马来西亚、澳大利亚、印度、土耳其、挪威、英国、丹麦、加拿大、阿根廷，以及4支全新赛区队伍：芬兰、哈萨克斯坦、中立队伍、乌克兰
总决赛：巅峰对决
时间：6月26日（周五）- 6月28日（周日），每日北京时间18:00开赛
场地：奖忠体育馆
赛制：每日5场比赛，共15场决战
总决赛的16支队伍由两部分组成：
– 8支种子队（直接晋级）：PNC 2025排名前8的队伍，包括越南、中国、泰国、美国、德国、巴西、印尼、韩国
– 8支突围赛晋级队伍：从突围赛中杀出重围的8支精英队伍
比赛地图：艾伦格、米拉玛、萨诺、泰戈、荣都五张地图轮换每天进行轮换。
二、赛事奖金池
本届PNC 2026全明星赛总奖金池高达50万美元，冠军队伍将独得13万美元的丰厚奖励。此外，赛事还增设了多项特殊奖项和PNC活动通行证的售卖收益，以鼓励选手们展现个人风采，比如：
– 总决赛阶段淘汰王：$15,000
– 总决赛阶段MVP选手：$10,000
– 总决赛阶段每场吃鸡队伍：$5,000 × 15场
三、      粉丝应援活动
为了让更多粉丝参与到赛事中来，本次PNC2026官方还特别推出了一系列活动。不仅能获得专属奖励，还有机会赢取G-Coin大奖！
活动1：粉丝应援
活动时间：2026年6月10日15:00 – 6月28日22:00（CST）
选择最喜欢的队伍即可获得 PNC 2026 名牌，幸运抽奖还会送出 G-Coin 给部分参与者。
活动2：Drops活动
在支持 Drops 的平台观看直播，就能根据观看时长获得特殊游戏道具。一边看精彩比赛，一边拿游戏奖励，这样的好事怎么能错过？
而且，最值得一提的是，本次PNC2026直播还在抖音、斗鱼、虎牙、快手平台开设了众多选手的个人视角，以一种全新的方式，让玩家与选手一起同屏竞技，感受比赛的激烈氛围，体验PNC2026总决赛的激情与热血。
四、赛事回顾与夺冠热门
在展望本届赛事之前，让我们先来回顾一下前两届PNC的精彩瞬间。
首先是2024年的PNC，主场作战的韩国队给所有观众留下了深刻印象。韩国队与美国队展开了惊心动魄的冠军争夺战，直到最后一场比赛的最后一刻才分出胜负。最终，韩国队以143分的总成绩，仅仅1分的微弱优势力压美国队，成功卫冕PNC冠军。
而PCL赛区代表队在那届赛事中经历了过山车般的体验。前两天的比赛，中国队发挥失常，排名一度跌落到谷底。但在最后一个比赛日，中国队的选手们彻底爆发，单日狂砍75分，上演了惊天大逆转，最终从倒数一路追到了第7名，让无数人看到了PCL赛区的潜力和韧性。
紧跟着的PNC2025，越南队则是成为了最大黑马，最终以创纪录的216分碾压夺冠，领先第二名中国队多达61分。这个分数也创造了PNC历史上的最高得分纪录。而对于PCL赛区来说，2025年的PNC同样具有里程碑意义。由Aixleft、MMing、Lilghost、Xwudd组成的中国队，最终以155分的成绩获得亚军，创造了PCL赛区在PNC赛事中的历史最佳战绩。
接下来我们再来看看PNC 2026，24支队伍同样各有千秋。但根据各队阵容配置、近期状态和历史战绩，同样有几支队伍被公认为最有力的冠军争夺者。
首先就是卫冕冠军越南队，今年越南队的阵容几乎完整保留，而且过往的PNC中，他们从未跌出过前四。TanVuu还是上一届PNC中以总淘汰第一名，总生存时间第二的非凡选手。虽然从PGS近期的比赛记录来看，这支战队略有波动，但很难说是赛前故意放出的烟雾弹，还是不小心露出的破绽。
接下来就是PCL赛区战队，3个17战队选手的加入，让这只战队拥有了非常高的投掷水平，在过往的PCL赛事不以及PGS赛事上，17战队也是榜单前列的常客。再加上PGS1上的MVP选手SpaceMan的加入，相信这次的比赛上，PCL赛区应该可以给我们带来一些更大的惊喜。
当然，夺冠热门必然也少不了东道主韩国队。2023-2024两度夺冠的成绩，让任何人都不敢小觑。从突击手Heather，到堪称六边形战士的Heaven，以及擅长凝聚团队战斗力的SeongJang等，韩国赛区今年的整体战力也是毫不逊色。
除此之外，还有美国、泰国等赛区的劲旅，同样也是这次PNC 2026上的夺冠热门。相信一切皆有可能，哪怕逆风也能上演绝地翻盘，这也正是电竞最大的魅力。
最后，本次比赛的PCL地区直播平台分别为抖音、斗鱼、虎牙、BILIBILI、微博，同时还邀请来了知名解说：Msjoy, Xie Yan, Simba, Feng Zheng, Yin Xi, Seven，BT, DouMu, Zhou Zhou。欢迎各位玩家前往观看，为喜欢的战队或选手加油，也别忘了参与粉丝应援活动，轻轻松松领取众多限定福利！
直播平台：
斗鱼：www.douyu.com/100
虎牙：https://www.huya.com/660004
哔哩哔哩：https://live.bilibili.com/11218604
微博：https://weibo.com/u/5911162580
抖音：https://v.douyin.com/Y1I8KOnC1Dk
快手：https://live.kuaishou.com/u/PUBG_Esports
特别鸣谢
感谢年度特约合作伙伴技嘉AORUS，行业合作伙伴AMD、卓威ZOWIE、Razer雷蛇、biubiu加速器、andaseaT安德斯特 对本次赛事的大力支持，是你们的助力让PCL更加精彩纷呈！
关于KRAFTON
KRAFTON（魁匠团）旗下拥有多个独立游戏开发团队，拥有《PUBG》、《ELYON》和《TERA》等多款游戏作品。公司名称源于核心价值观“匠人精神”，包含着制作游戏大作的匠人精神、不惧失败的挑战精神。KRAFTON目前由“PUBG Studio”，“Bluehole Studio”，“Rising Wings”，“Striking Distance Studio”，“Dream Motion”，“Unknown Worlds”，“5minlab”和多个制作组构成，更多关于KRAFTON的信息，敬请访问https://www.krafton.com。

首先就是卫冕冠军越南队，今年越南队的阵容几乎完整保留，而且过往的PNC中，他们从未跌出过前四。TanVuu还是上一届PNC中以总淘汰第一名，总生存时间第二的非凡选手。虽然从PGS近期的比赛记录来看，这支战队略有波动，但很难说是赛前故意放出的烟雾弹，还是不小心露出的破绽。

接下来就是PCL赛区战队，3个17战队选手的加入，让这只战队拥有了非常高的投掷水平，在过往的PCL赛事不以及PGS赛事上，17战队也是榜单前列的常客。再加上PGS1上的MVP选手SpaceMan的加入，相信这次的比赛上，PCL赛区应该可以给我们带来一些更大的惊喜。

当然，夺冠热门必然也少不了东道主韩国队。2023-2024两度夺冠的成绩，让任何人都不敢小觑。从突击手Heather，到堪称六边形战士的Heaven，以及擅长凝聚团队战斗力的SeongJang等，韩国赛区今年的整体战力也是毫不逊色。

除此之外，还有美国、泰国等赛区的劲旅，同样也是这次PNC 2026上的夺冠热门。相信一切皆有可能，哪怕逆风也能上演绝地翻盘，这也正是电竞最大的魅力。

最后，本次比赛的PCL地区直播平台分别为抖音、斗鱼、虎牙、BILIBILI、微博，同时还邀请来了知名解说：Msjoy, Xie Yan, Simba, Feng Zheng, Yin Xi, Seven，BT, DouMu, Zhou Zhou。欢迎各位玩家前往观看，为喜欢的战队或选手加油，也别忘了参与粉丝应援活动，轻轻松松领取众多限定福利！

title: 版本公测开启！魔域口袋版全新地图/美女直播等你上线！
text:
亚特大陆风云再起，神选者的征程迎来全新篇章！《魔域口袋版》2026年度核心资料片“神兵启世”正式定档6月26日全服上线。这不仅是年内最大规模的版本迭代，更是一次涵盖地图、装备、副本、养成、情怀五大维度的全量级革新。而在正式上线前夕，一场属于全体玩家的狂欢盛宴将提前点燃——“神兵启世”版本公测直播即将震撼开启，锁定6月26日18:30官方直播间，美女主播带你抢先探秘全新版本，官方现场送神器，全程福利不间断！
全新大陆“神陨之地”揭幕，迷雾探索等你开荒
本次资料片最受瞩目的重磅内容，当属全新大陆「神陨之地」的正式开放。这片终年被古神力笼罩、隔绝外界的禁忌之地，隐藏着千年秘辛与失落的神迹。伴随着愈演愈烈的未知迷雾缓缓浮出水面，失落的古神遗迹以及前所未有的奇遇冒险，都等待着各位神选者亲自揭开。
新大陆目前开放遗忘荒漠与朽梦幽泽两大特色片区。禁地外围的遗忘荒漠是昔日古神战场化作的无垠黄沙，遍地神骸与断壁残垣诉说着当年惊天一战的惨烈；深入腹地的朽梦幽泽则黑雾缭绕、瘴气丛生，幻境迷局无处不在，只有意志坚定的勇者方能寻得一线生机。
探索这片禁地需要消耗专属体力“时之息”——每位玩家上线即送100点，每小时自动回复10点，存储上限为200点。每天累计消耗100点时之息即可领取固定每日奖励，还能开启神遗宝匣。地图内设有主线奇遇与随机触发的支线奇遇，完成各类奇遇任务均可领取丰厚奖励。此外还有普通秘境与稀有秘境两大趣味玩法等待挑战。率先入驻的玩家将成为这片新土地的拓荒先行者，抢占资源点位，拿下版本开荒的第一桶金。
五阶神器降临，战力体系全面进化
“神兵启世”版本重磅推出五阶神器，战斗力体系迎来全面升级！神等级上限开放至50级，现有四阶神器可直接升阶为五阶，老玩家无缝衔接。
神器新增神威特殊属性词条位，在打造过程中有概率触发。单把神器最多只能拥有1条神威属性，稀缺性直接拉满。神器、魔魂追加等级上限同步提升至+70。五阶神器可通过新神阶副本、12星副本以及神陨之地探索获取。
全新“神器灵锻”玩法同步上线，玩家可将闲置的特殊属性装备作为“养料”，持续淬炼主力五阶神器的属性。那些长期压在背包角落里的属性装备，终于迎来了用武之地。灵锻让养成从“一次性毕业”转变为“每一步都看得见提升”。
两大全新副本，机制为王挑战极限
两大全新副本同步推出，为硬核玩家带来全新挑战。
“天下入卷”副本内含5位BOSS，包含特色双生BOSS机制。卷中余音·韵BOSS划分五音区域，释放大招时需根据提示及时切换站位；千秋一弈·甫BOSS战场为九宫格局，黑白棋势相互制衡。每一个BOSS都拥有专属趣味机制，极度考验团队配合。
“霜绝王座”副本则分为森罗、梦魇、炼狱三种难度，每个难度下设10个星级。难度及星级越高，奖励越丰厚。霜绝王座设有3个常规BOSS与1个隐藏BOSS，每位BOSS技能极具特色——远古魔蛇拥有石化机制，碎心之王附带特殊情绪机制，是五阶神器的核心产出来源。
今晚公测直播，神器福利等你来拿
在6月26日全服上线之际，“神兵启世”版本公测直播将于6月26日18:30在官方直播间震撼开启！这不仅是版本全服上线前的重磅预热活动，更是一场福利拉满的狂欢之夜。
官方直播间将为大家带来最全面的版本解读、最硬核的玩法演示。更值得期待的是，直播期间将现场派发神器，全程福利不间断——从稀有道具到高阶材料，从绝版外观到限定好礼，福利覆盖方方面面。每一位蹲守直播间的神选者，都有机会成为那个被幸运砸中的天选之人！
神兵在手，神陨任行——6月26日，让我们一起踏入焕然一新的亚特大陆，打破战力桎梏，书写属于自己的全新魔域传奇！
（请以正式服游戏上线版本为准）

title: DOTA2全新大型活动暗黑狂欢上线！5款机关人身心，15款英雄套装，更有海量免费福利等你解锁
text:
2026年6月26日，DOTA2全新大型活动暗黑狂欢上线。活动期间玩家可以通过游玩DOTA2比赛，指引森海飞霞和军团指挥官穿过百戏大王的马戏团专列，同时解锁沿途的英雄套装、珍藏宝箱、语音轮盘、折扣金币等全新奖励。
本次暗黑狂欢活动还推出了 全新机关人身心 和 灵幻奇观的珍藏 。 斧王、军团指挥官、神谕者、变体精灵和钢背兽 获得了机关人身心饰品，拥有了全新动作、自定义特效和图标，以及全新配音效果。 灵幻奇观的珍藏内含15款嘉年华主题英雄套装 ，其中米拉娜套装拥有孟加拉虎和白虎两款霸气威武的坐骑，饰品稀有的艾欧则化身为水晶球和占卜师的结合体，充满了神秘色彩。现在前往DOTA2客户端或完美世界电竞APP即可购买。
【新模型！新动作！新特效！新配音！五款机关人身心上线】
斧王、军团指挥官、神谕者、变体精灵和钢背兽 被精心拆解，并重新组装成机械怪物狂欢机关人！每个机关人都封装了全新动作、自定义特效和图标、全新配音效果等等！
斧王机关人身心拥有全新英雄模型，他将用全新的淘汰之刃特效在敌人身上测试您的力量，并且用全新的反击螺旋动作给敌人一个惊喜！斧王机关人身心更新了全新机器人效果的配音台词，新的身心还完全支持所有斧王的嘲讽动作！
军团指挥官机关人身心拥有让敌人心生恐惧的焕然一新的外观，全新震撼的压倒性优势和决斗视觉特效，以及流畅优美的自定义移动动作！所有的军团指挥官配音台词都经过了数字化增强，并且特殊的电动技术完全支持所有军团指挥官的嘲讽动作！
神谕者机关人身心拥有闪亮的带有周身特效的全新英雄模型，未来主义的气运之末和命运敕令替代特效，并且拥有包括移动和传送的自定义替代动作！神谕者机关人身心的语音台词都更新为加强版效果，新的身心支持非机关神谕者的嘲讽动作！
变体精灵机关人身心拥有造型流畅、细节丰富的全新英雄模型，全新波浪形态视觉特效，以及包括移动、拆卸等等的自定义替代动作！机关人身心语音台词都更新为全新的机械效果！
钢背兽机关人身心拥有全新耐酒精金属结构，包含后置式火焰排气管的完全安全的周身特效，以及粘稠鼻液、刺针扫射和毛团的非生物替代特效！钢背兽机关人身心语音台词都更新成了机器人变声效果，新身心的内部齿轮系统完全支持所有钢背兽的嘲讽动作！
【全新珍藏闪亮登场，马戏团里你指定谁做小丑？】
灵幻奇观的珍藏与暗黑狂欢活动一同上线，珍藏内含15款真正独特的吸睛套装，包括不朽尸王、痛苦女王、天穹守望者、巨魔战将、死亡先知、幻影长矛手、破晓辰星、圣堂刺客、齐天大圣、帕吉、獸、米拉娜、邪影芳灵和艾欧的嘉年华主题全新英雄套装。
其中帕吉套装伐木魔偶为身心套装，解开伐木魔偶套装时，如果还未拥有帕吉身心玩具屠夫，将额外获得玩具屠夫套装。
獸套装压轴大毛兽为珍稀级别额外奖励，失去了原生毛发和皮肤，被针线和棉布修补，压轴大毛兽拥有着别样的外表，却一样令敌人望而生畏。
另一款珍稀级别额外奖励为米拉娜套装月神名伶，该套装的坐骑部位拥有两个款式，分别为凶猛的孟加拉虎和高洁的白虎，骑上之后走出个虎虎生威，走出个一日千里，走出个恍如隔世。
非常珍稀级别的额外奖励为邪影芳灵套装邪魅仙娘，古灵精怪的“花仙”变成了小丑模样，配合上灵动精准的技能释放，邪魅仙娘在战场上会将她的敌人们一一变成“小丑”。
珍稀超凡级别额外奖励为艾欧套装卜命夫人，神秘的水晶球中隐约可见占卜师的头颅，战场上跟紧艾欧，它会为你带来胜利的预言。

title: 随时随地舒服一下，治愈系小岛生活模拟《舒舒服服小岛时光》TapTap预约开启！
text:
Steam平台以慢节奏小岛生活模拟而获得特别好评的轻松治愈游戏《舒舒服服小岛时光》即将上线移动平台，让大家随时随地体验悠闲享受的小岛生活。游戏将参加7月2日的TapTap游戏发布会，现已在TapTap开启预约，预计年内开启测试。
游戏链接： https://l.taptap.cn/O2VzqZZV?channel=rep-rep_kcw5khyi8rr
《舒舒服服小岛时光》是一款有着浓郁度假放松氛围的休闲游戏，堪称“虚拟海岛农家乐”。在这个小岛上，玩家可以充分远离喧闹嘈杂的城市，尽情享受单纯清净的田园生活。
海岛的舒服来自优渥的环境，在小岛上，大家可以尽情享受种植与丰收的喜悦，不必担心虫害或天灾的袭扰，甚至连作物的成长速度都如神话中那样的迅速，快乐只多不少。
悠闲是小岛生活的主调，在无拘无束的自由时光里，玩家有充足空间去欣赏绿意盎然的风景，静下心来放空头脑。顺路帮小岛上的居民送送东西吧，做些好人好事总会有不错的回报。
既然是海岛，少不了与大海去打交道，各种各样的鱼类收集起来是非常有成就感的目标。尤其是一些稀有的收获，抱在怀里绝对能激起钓鱼佬的骄傲。
这是一座充满家乡感的小岛，同时也隐藏有众多值得去发掘的神秘惊喜。随意探索过程中，玩家总会感受到新发现的乐趣，可能是罕见的奇珍异宝，也可能是功能有趣的神奇道具。
悠闲时光下，岛上总有各式各样预想不到的互动活动，踢足球、放烟花或者是……意料之外的奇遇？
但相信邂逅可爱的小动物们，收集打造各种家具，装扮，像个孩子那样单纯地在岛上折腾，已经足够让大家感到小岛生活的幸福了~
独乐乐不如众乐乐，小岛让人一眼就感到呆萌可爱的美术风格不仅限于外表，拉上朋友一起多人体验的乐趣更让温馨感倍增，让岛上成了一起舒舒服服度假的好去处。
在这里，大家可以无伤大雅地搞出很多夸张好玩的事儿，像是谁忽然冷不丁掏出不知道哪里捡的“爆炸魔杖”就会……
就跟在现实里度假一样，跟朋友在一起，最重要的不是游玩的地点，而是一起搭伙留下的美好回忆。
合影，是回到这份美好回忆的一个钥匙。
当然，这座小岛上自然也可以干脆啥都不干，就只躺在一起发发呆聊聊天，任由这段相伴的时间悄然流逝而去。
让心灵的花朵获得轻松滋润，便是这段舒舒服服小岛时光的意义。
治愈系小岛生活模拟《舒舒服服小岛时光》TapTap预约现已开启，如果想随时体验这份轻松惬意的治愈感，就先来订下一座自己的小岛，期待一段无忧无虑的躺平时光吧。

title: 动作肉鸽独游《梦之形》夏促开启限时史低折扣，手游版预约上线TapTap
text:
由韩国4人独游团队Lizard Smoothie研发，融合MOBA元素的差异化动作肉鸽独游《梦之形》，现已开启30%OFF夏促限时史低折扣， 折后售价仅需61.6元。
伴随本次夏促，官方同步宣布， 《梦之形》将亮相7月2日TapTap游戏发布会，游戏手游版已在TapTap开放预约。
游戏页面： https://l.taptap.cn/jPBVXCus?channel=rep-rep_hznmifzxroe
挑战变化莫测的梦境世界
作为一款融合MOBA元素的动作肉鸽游戏，《梦之形》为玩家编织出了一个千变万化的梦境世界。游戏中，玩家将化身旅行者，在“急流”中穿梭梦境世界，在电光石火的激斗中粉碎梦境桎梏。
游戏以多样的技能结构作为局内构筑核心，技能涵盖元素攻击、机动控制、机制变异等不同类型。技能设计上，《梦之形》汲取了MOBA游戏的典型风格，涵盖伤害、附魔、生存等多种类型，呈现出复合而多元的战术选择。
由于允许玩家随时替换技能，并融入了更进一步的“精粹”符文系统，这些额外插槽可对技能进行本质性改造，如将单体技变为范围效果、为大招添加充能机制等，真正实现“每局都是新体验”。
超长售后，更新不断
Lizard Smoothie对玩家反馈的响应速度一向很快。自上线以来，除迅速针对玩家意见进行内容优化，团队还按计划稳步扩充着大家喜闻乐见的游戏内容。
从创意工坊，到迷失域，如果说2026年春季更新的调整是“让积灰的记忆和精粹重新上桌”，夏季更新则是一场大刀阔斧的焕新改革。
随着暗影手雷、空翻、灵魂伴侣；玻璃精粹、熔岩精粹、纯净精粹这些新记忆和新精粹的加入，旅行者在急流探索中的BD上限进一步拓宽。新的清醒梦也为玩家展开了更多可探索的梦境空间。
对于硬核肉鸽玩家而言，本次夏季版本更新让暗影之箭、黑色长矛、影步等一系列老记忆迎来质变。现在它们能够根据玩家的暴击率获得伤害增幅或触发强力的特殊效果，使以往单纯溢出的暴击率在全新版本里有了用武之地。
梦境拓展，手游版开启预约
在持续丰富梦境的同时，Lizard Smoothie也在尝试将梦境拓展到更多舞台。除了与《鸦卫奇旅》推出全新捆绑包外，《梦之形》还与T1电子竞技俱乐部携手推出了联动表情包。
而通过与心动合作，《梦之形》也计划未来将原汁原味登陆到移动端，在手机上为玩家带来同样丰富完整的梦境探险体验。
7月2日，《梦之形》将在TapTap游戏发布会公开游戏的更多资讯，游戏手机版也已在TapTap开放预约。
对还未踏入这次梦境的新旅行者而言，本次夏促的史低折扣无疑是开启冒险的绝佳时机。在这个暑期，就让《梦之形》随时随地给大家带来酣畅战斗的割草快感。

title: 剑侠再启，江湖重逢｜虎牙×西山居匠心新作《剑侠情缘：重逢》正式启宣
text:
从“鹅鸭杀”到“江湖梦”，当直播生态流量布局碰撞国产武侠经典IP，一场跨越时代的江湖重逢，正式拉开序幕。
今日，由 虎牙发行、西山居 《 剑侠世界 》 端游原班核心团队研发 的武侠新作《剑侠情缘：重逢》正式对外启宣，APP、PC端、小程序三端同步布局，以经典武侠内核为根，以轻量化、传统玩法为翼，为新老玩家重铸一个有温度、有侠义、有烟火气的真实江湖。
虎牙发行版图持续深耕，从《鹅鸭杀》社交爆款，入局国民武侠赛道
作为国内头部直播平台，虎牙早已不止于内容生态搭建，而是深度布局游戏发行领域，以 内容+流量+社区+赛事 的独特发行优势，打造多款国民级爆款产品。此前，虎牙联合金山世游发行的《鹅鸭杀》国服手游，凭借强社交、强博弈、强直播属性，登顶各大应用商店榜单，成为当下年轻人最喜爱的社交推理游戏之一，验证了虎牙“内容驱动发行、社交赋能游戏”的独特打法。
此次携手西山居推出《剑侠情缘：重逢》，是虎牙发行矩阵的重要战略落子。从年轻社交派对游戏，到沉淀二十余年的国民武侠IP，虎牙依托海量主播生态、直播社区流量、成熟的玩家运营体系，将为这款经典武侠新作带来全新的破圈可能，让老牌武侠IP拥抱新生代玩家，实现经典江湖的年轻化、社交化焕新。
原班人马匠心回归，复刻2008剑侠世界经典，续写西山居武侠基因
提起国产武侠，绕不开 西山居与剑侠情缘 。作为与《仙剑奇侠传》《轩辕剑》并称“国产三剑”的国民IP，剑侠情缘自1997年初代单机问世，历经端游、手游二十余年沉淀，而2008年上线的《剑侠世界》端游，更是无数武侠玩家心中的白月光。
本次《剑侠情缘：重逢》，由 2008年剑侠世界端游原班核心研发团队亲自操刀 。团队深耕武侠赛道十余年，深谙老玩家心中的江湖情怀，完整继承剑侠系列核心世界观、门派设定、白虎堂、宋金战场等经典玩法，拒绝魔改、拒绝快餐化。在保留原汁原味武侠内核的基础上，针对当下玩家习惯优化操作、节奏与社交模式，让老玩家找回当年热血，让新玩家感受正统武侠的魅力。
三端互通全场景上线，APP+PC+小程序，随时随地奔赴江湖
为打破传统武侠游戏的场景限制，降低江湖入局门槛，《剑侠情缘：重逢》打造 手机APP、PC客户端、小程序三端互通 模式，数据完全打通，多端无缝切换。
除PC端和APP端外，重点的小程序端无需下载，点开即玩，轻量化体验经典门派、休闲玩法。一游三端，兼顾硬核与休闲，让武侠江湖不再受设备与场景束缚，真正实现“随时重逢，即刻入江湖”。
二十余年剑侠IP底蕴，正统武侠世界观，侠义江湖再续前缘
剑侠情缘IP，始于南宋乱世，根植家国侠义，从单机时代的独孤剑、杨影枫，到端游时代的十大门派、宋金抗金，早已构建起庞大、完整、深入人心的武侠宇宙。
《剑侠情缘：重逢》延续剑侠正统世界观，复刻经典门派体系，还原五行相生相克的战斗逻辑，回归宋金战场、野外PK、家族团战、师徒情缘等标志性玩法。不堆砌浮夸特效，不脱离武侠内核，专注打造快意恩仇、兄弟结义、江湖侠义的真实武侠体验，让玩家在刀光剑影间，重温年少江湖梦。
社交武侠双向赋能，虎牙生态加持，打造有温度的新生代江湖
虎牙成熟的直播社区、主播矩阵、玩家社群运营，将深度赋能《剑侠情缘：重逢》。游戏内家族社交、师徒情缘、阵营对抗，结合虎牙直播生态，玩家既能沉浸式体验武侠战斗，也能一键开启直播、分享江湖日常，实现“游戏社交+直播社交”双重乐趣。
我们拒绝单机式武侠，打造 有兄弟、有情缘、有恩怨、有烟火 的鲜活江湖，既保留经典武侠的热血，又适配当下年轻人的社交习惯，让老牌武侠IP在新时代焕发全新生命力。
初心未改，江湖重逢｜预约开启，共赴二十余年侠义之约
少年曾仗剑，江湖今重逢。
《剑侠情缘：重逢》现已正式开启启宣预约，虎牙将联合西山居持续放出研发实录、门派爆料、预约专属福利。从《鹅鸭杀》的欢乐博弈，到剑侠情缘的侠义江湖，虎牙与西山居始终坚守初心，用优质内容与匠心产品，陪伴每一位玩家。
点击链接，填写招募问卷，即刻抢测试激活码！先到先得！剑侠江湖，拔剑重燃！
问卷地址：https://jxqy-survey.huya.cn/#/v6/diaowen/an/cjq6auqvr87
各位少侠还可以加入《剑侠情缘：重逢》备战群，和各位江湖豪侠一同踏上重逢之路！
QQ群号：930558345
一键加群链接：https://qun.qq.com/certify-share/s/bfqkiUWg3E?_nsp=1
这一次，旧友重逢，新朋相聚，我们在《剑侠情缘：重逢》，等你共赴一场跨越时光的武侠之约。

title: Steam夏促开启，来2P Games一站式入坑，权谋战棋到修仙肉鸽全都有
text:
Steam夏促都开了，还在纠结玩什么？2P Games多款精品佳作集体迎来史低折扣！从权谋叙事、硬核战棋到修仙种田、银河肉鸽全都给你备齐，总有一款能让你假期忍不住“再来一把”。
• 《苏丹的游戏》 | -20% | 折后价64元
商店链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3117820/_/
发售后持续一年免费更新，游戏体量翻倍，但价格创新低？暴君模拟器，但主角不是你？2025年Indie Live Expo 年度游戏，用400万字的文本搭配卡牌元素、资源管理，带你沉浸式体验权力的“甜美”。
你将在死亡的威胁下，与苏丹进行一场周而复始的残酷游戏，不断抽取并执行“苏丹卡”所赋予的疯狂任务——奢靡无度、纵情声色、血腥杀戮、掠夺征服。是玩弄他人的命运，还是救赎自己的灵魂，在这场疯狂的游戏中做出你的选择吧！
• 《少女与学院城》 | -20% | 折后价60.8元
商店链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639650/_/
Boss Rush模式上线，鉴赏画廊实装，立绘香，战斗爽，还没有坐牢的跳跳乐？这才是银河城！
一款横版类银河恶魔城游戏，玩家将扮演交流生“小玉”，踏上成为“卡梅尔之星”的旅程。探索错综复杂的学院城，在动态变化的场景中收集武器、能力、获得海量隐藏道具。与怪诞的敌人展开强交互、快节奏的正面对决。结识形形色色的学生，解救处于危机中的学院，并揭开学院城与自身隐藏的真相！
• 《轮回保险公司 R.I.P》 | -15%新史低！| 折后价37.4元
商店链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3985950/_RIP/
新地图天穹堡垒上线，新型变异领主加入战场，无限复活的打工人，挑战地狱级KPI，构筑逆天Build横扫尸潮。
在这款融合了射击割草与暗黑刷宝的肉鸽游戏中，扮演轮回保险公司的精英员工。凭借无限复活的能力深入感染区，搜集传奇装备、构筑强力Build，击败强大的变异领主。通关小秘境，激活强力套装契约。挑战大秘境，永久提升技能等级。在无尽的轮回中不断成长——直到成为真正的救世传奇。
• 《潘多拉的玩具盒》| -10% | 折后价32.4元
商店链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3030190/_/
挂机看海养电子盆栽，下场微操斗赛博蛐蛐，带小部落一路卷成超级大国。
这是一款快节奏的Rogue上帝模拟沙盒游戏。玩家将化身希腊神祇埃庇米修斯，在随机生成的像素大陆上创造并引导文明发展。见证人类从聚落迈向城邦，抵御异教势力入侵，并在跨位面的神系战争中扩张信仰。不断强化神力、召集众神，在一次次文明演化中建立属于你的永恒国度。
• 《银河灰暗角落》 | -15%新史低！ | 折后价35.7元
商店链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3129930/_/
游戏支持创意工坊，欢迎各位手工耿上太空、拼好舰
这是一款公司外勤题材的太空策略rogue游戏：率领舰队出勤替公司卖命，在战斗与事件抉择中打捞残骸回收资产，用各种处理方式，应对星区里的三教九流；用任务报酬组建私人武装，在充满黑色幽默的对话中，学习灰色地带的生存法则，在银河的灰暗角落，努力活下去。
• 《圣女战旗》 | -80% | 折后价13.6元
商店链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/994730/_/
角色日语配音上线，战斗表现全面提升。本来冲着立绘买的，结果被战棋硬控？
一款以法国大革命为背景的策略战棋游戏。扮演觉醒了圣女之力的波利娜·波拿巴，周旋于巴黎的各方势力之间，结识并培养30多位出身各异的角色。在30多张地图中，利用地形和天气创造优势，指挥多兵种协同作战击败强敌，书写英雄史诗！
• 《回溯依存》 | -70%新史低！| 折后价11.4元
商店链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398740/_/
封闭校舍上演轮回杀人案，失踪女友再度现身?克苏鲁、百合与推理交织的双向救赎之旅。
这是一款悬疑推理AVG。伊吹兰为寻找神秘失踪的女友辗转世界各地，却在某日发现自己不知何时来到了一间神秘的旧校舍。面对周遭诡异的氛围，伊吹兰只想尽快离开，但是突如其来的杀人事件和学校里接踵而至的谜团，使她不得不留在这里……
• 《职场浮生记》 | -40% | 折后价33.6元
商店链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1360810/_/
可以操作的职场爽文，需要带娃的galgame？
一款剧情向生活模拟游戏。扮演初入社会的大学生，开启传奇人生，通过在日常工作生活中积累阅历，获得500+种卡牌构筑你的工作流派，轻松搞定大项目。体验超200万字的多彩人生：一路晋升高层，出走自立门户，甚至参与商战博弈。上班摸鱼炒股、下班健身逛街、结交数百名角色，攻略五位女主，书写属于你的职场爽文。
• 《地心归途》 | -45%新史低！| 折后价30.8元
商店链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171630/_/
科研靠考古，种地靠老婆？国产游戏总能整点新花样
一款结合挖掘探索、建造、自动化、以及魔物娘的沙盒冒险游戏。你将作为文明的幸存者，深入神秘的地下世界，搭建营地，适应残酷的生存环境，回收失落科技建设地心工厂，结识并培养魔物娘伙伴，让她们协助战斗与生产，踏上重返地表的归途。
• 《一方灵田》 | -65%新史低！| 折后价20.3元
商店链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201230/_/
仙术种田、法器务农？修仙人的生产力堪称降维打击
一款广受好评的国风修仙生活模拟游戏，带你体验闲云野鹤般的别样修仙生活，于幽静的山谷中潜心修道，在繁华的市井中品味人间烟火，经营山谷，种田养蚕，秘境历练，炼丹突破。和诸多个性鲜明的伙伴们一起重建山门振兴门派！
从宫廷权谋到仙乡日常，就用2P Games的必玩佳作填满你的夏日游戏清单吧。

title: 深入禁区清除感染《轮回保险公司R.I.P》全新版本“天穹堡垒”上线
text:
融合了射击割草与暗黑刷宝的Roguelike游戏《轮回保险公司R.I.P》全新版本“天穹堡垒”今日重磅上线，并在夏促期间开启新史低特惠，现在购买仅需37.4元。化身无限复活的打工人，挑战地狱级KPI，构筑逆天Build横扫尸潮。
曾经作为人类最大避所之一的天穹堡垒，如今已沦为感染者的温床。生化感染不断扩散，此地的智能中枢也启动了无差别防御协议。请立前往该区域展开净化行动，重新夺回“管理权限”。
商店链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3985950/_RIP/
本次更新新增4种普通怪物、2种精英敌人与2个全新BOSS，这些可怕的敌人将会在天穹堡垒中现身。
BOSS-雷殛守卫
BOSS-灾变雷龙
新增2种天穹堡垒BOSS的专属掉落暗金装备
芯片-「星环弹珠」：换弹后，召唤多个能量球如群星般围绕自身急速旋转。
手雷-「恶龙吐息」：射击命中敌人一定次数后，召唤雷龙向前方吐息。
此外，本次版本还对模式与地图选择界面进行了重构，使其更加直观清晰；并对装备模组、天赋与科技系统进行了全面强化升级，进一步强化持续火力，拓展更多Build流派。
你将深入沼泽、荒漠与冻土执行高危任务，在战场上搜寻补给，向尸潮倾泻火力，挑战变异领主，以极限走位拉扯击败强敌，畅享火力全开的割草快感。
5位专员各持专精武器，不同口径带来扎实射击反馈。战斗中可获取空投支援，解锁冰冻、电弧、烈焰等元素能力，或呼叫无人机、机炮、卫星射线展开降维打击，自由组合Build，感受溢出屏幕弹幕风暴。

title: 100部好书等着被做成游戏，这可能是出版业和游戏业最近的一次
author: 郝磅磅
text:
前段时间，《地铁》系列让不少玩家通关后翻开了格鲁霍夫斯基的同名小说，想看看原著里的阿尔乔姆和游戏有什么不同。但反过来想，如果你是一个游戏开发者，想要把一本好书改编成游戏，该从哪一步开始？
这个问题听起来简单，实际上却是一道不少人卡在原地的门槛。在游戏行业，IP改编早已不是新鲜事。影视、动漫、网文，几乎每年都有大IP改编的游戏产品面世。但如果你仔细观察，会发现一个有趣的现象：传统图书，尤其是严肃文学和出版领域的优质作品，几乎从未真正进入游戏改编的视野。
不是没有先例。阿加莎·克里斯蒂的推理小说被多次改编成冒险解谜游戏，封闭空间中的猜疑与推理自然地变成了玩家的判断与选择；洛夫克拉夫特的克苏鲁神话更是一整类恐怖游戏的精神源头，那种“越理解越疯狂”的恐惧，被转化为“理智值”这一核心游戏机制。在国内，也偶尔能看到一些互动影像作品，从文字冒险的土壤里生长出来。但整体而言，传统出版IP与游戏之间的通道，一直像是隔着一层透明的墙。
原因并不复杂。一方面，传统出版机构对游戏行业的了解有限，版权授权的流程和模式尚未跑通，很多出版社甚至不知道该怎么给一本小说的游戏改编权定价；另一方面，游戏开发者在选择IP时，天然倾向于已有庞大粉丝基础的网文和动漫，出版领域的优质内容反而不在可选之列。
两个行业各忙各的，中间缺少一座桥。这两年国内的游戏创作赛事，开始有人试着搭这座桥了。
国内的游戏创作赛事并不少，从游戏公司举办的创作大赛到各类高校Gamejam，很多地方政府也开始将游戏赛会作为城市品牌建设的一部分。一些地方性的赛事开始尝试差异化的思路，不再只是给开发者一个舞台，而是从供给端解决实际问题，提供IP、打通版权通道、对接出版资源。
这种思路的转变背后，是地方对游戏产业认知的升级。游戏不再只是一个需要管的行业，它也是一种内容产业。当一个城市想要发展文化创意产业时，与其从零开始建一条生产线，不如把现有的资源串起来，出版行业有内容，游戏行业有技术和创意，而搭建联动机制就成了关键所在。
一场关于内容与创意的游戏大赛便应运而生——“金版杯”故事游戏速创赛。这项由天津市版权局、天津市版权协会指导，天津市河北区人民政府、天津出版传媒集团有限公司、天津美术学院联合主办的赛事，把100部出版物的游戏改编权开放给参赛者。100部作品里包括2024年“中国好书”《我的世界》、中华优秀出版物奖提名奖《纸飞机》等获过权威认可的优质IP，涵盖科幻、历史、悬疑等多种题材。换句话说，这个赛事不是让你想一个好故事，而是给你一个已经验证过的好故事，让你想想它还能变成什么。
赛事提供授权作品库
“故事游戏”这个概念，是理解这项赛事的关键。
过去说到文学改编游戏，很多人的第一反应可能是“剧情向”“文字AVG”，好像文学性只能以最朴素的方式存在于游戏中。但实际上，近年来以叙事为核心的游戏已经发展出了极其丰富的形态。从《极乐迪斯科》用对话树构建的哲学思辨，到《苏丹的游戏》用卡牌叙事重构权力博弈，再到《完美的一天》用时间循环让每一次选择都有回响。故事不再是游戏的包装，而是游戏本身，玩家期待看到叙事与游戏机制的深度融合。
这就引出了一个很有意思的命题：当一个传统故事被交到游戏开发者手中，它应该被还原还是被重构？
我们倾向于认为，好的改编应该是重构。就像《苏丹的游戏》并不是在“还原”奥斯曼帝国的宫廷政治，而是把权力博弈的故事转化为一种独特的卡牌叙事玩法。同理，推理小说的悬疑也好，科幻作品的想象也好，它们的价值不在于被原封不动地搬进游戏，而在于为游戏设计提供一种独特的叙事原材料，这种原材料自带情感厚度和文化积淀，是凭空构思难以获得的。
这也是传统出版IP与游戏结合的真正潜力所在。网文IP的优势在于流量和粉丝基础，但出版IP的优势在于内容的完成度、叙事的成熟度和主题的深度。当游戏行业越来越需要好故事来支撑更长的体验周期时，出版行业恰好坐拥着大量经过读者筛选的优质内容。两边的需求其实高度互补。
当然，从互补到结合，中间还有很多实际的问题需要解决：版权怎么谈、改编怎么改、产品怎么推、成本怎么算……每一个环节都是门槛。“金版杯”的做法是把这些门槛尽量往下压，开放版权库、提供引导资金、给予投资孵化对接和游戏出版全流程辅导。相当于既给你原材料，又帮你搭生产线，还帮你找销路。对于很多有想法但缺资源的独立开发者和小团队来说，这种一条龙式的支持，可能比奖金本身更有吸引力。
回头看，出版业和游戏业的距离，可能比很多人以为的要近。一个是人类最古老的故事载体，一个是最年轻的故事载体，它们之间的代际差异确实存在，但核心都是讲好一个故事，让体验它的人有所触动。
100部好书已经摆在那里，等着被赋予新的形态。至于它们会成为什么样的游戏，就看参赛者能不能让这些故事，从纸页上真正“活”过来了。

title: 2026年第二十三届ChinaJoy定档7月31日“与AI同游”引领全球数字娱乐新风向
author: 郝磅磅
text:
2026年第二十三届中国国际数码互动娱乐展览会（ChinaJoy）新闻发布会今日在上海国际会议中心举行。会上宣布，本届展会将于7月31日至8月3日在上海新国际博览中心举办，主题定为“与AI同游”，将以空前的游戏试玩阵容与前沿AI技术生态为核心驱动，全面呈现数字娱乐产业最新成果。
中国音像与数字出版协会副秘书长、游戏工委秘书长、电竞工委主任委员唐贾军，上海市委宣传部文化改革发展处处长、网络出版处处长陆以威出席并致辞。陆以威表示，依托上海“游戏沪十条”政策赋能，上海网游产业出海增速亮眼。本届ChinaJoy将举办第二届中国国际游戏开发者大会、全球电竞大会，升级文商旅体展融合，打造国潮特色展区，助力上海“全球电竞之都”“游戏创新之城”建设。上海汉威信恒展览有限公司总经理万方昱主持发布会，介绍展会整体筹备情况及核心亮点。
出席此次新闻发布会的全体嘉宾
中国音像与数字出版协会副秘书长、游戏工委秘书长、电竞工委主任委员 唐贾军
上海市委宣传部文化改革发展处处长、网络出版处处长 陆以威
上海汉威信恒展览有限公司总经理 万方昱
规模再创新高，千余款游戏作品及热点产品亮相
本届ChinaJoy总展览面积超14万平方米，截至目前已有近900家企业参展，其中外资企业275家，来自美国、加拿大、英国、德国、日本、韩国等39个国家和地区。其中，BTOC互动娱乐馆面积近12万平方米，汇聚超350家企业；BTOB商务洽谈馆面积2.5万平方米，超500家企业入驻，外资企业占比达46.6%。本届展会将有超500家游戏公司及团队带来逾1000款游戏产品现场亮相，Steam线上盛典报名游戏超600款。科技、硬件、潮玩、汽车等多领域头部企业亦将携千余款热点产品参展，共筑夏日数字娱乐盛宴。
重磅产品精彩聚集，互动体验全面升级
腾讯游戏、网易游戏、暴雪游戏、世纪华通、巨人网络、完美世界、金山世游、中国移动咪咕互娱、朝夕光年、顺网科技、PlayStation、360游戏、恺英网络、B站游戏、麟贝互娱、4399&好游快爆、Pocketpair等500余家厂商提供超千款游戏线下试玩，多个试玩区汇集众多精彩独立游戏；高通联合产业生态伙伴打造骁龙主题馆，以“AI驱动体验进化”为核心，呈现多终端融合的沉浸式数字娱乐体验。宇树科技、逐际动力、魔法原子、露米智能、云幕智造等企业携人形机器人与具身智能产品集中亮相，开启互动新体验。迈从、狼蛛、VGN、维信诺、ATK GEAR、前行者、aigo、变体精灵、铠侠、拜雅、闪迪、梵想等品牌齐聚；中关村在线携手三星、联想、佳能、海康威视、长江存储、HKC、爱攻等20家品牌打造科技娱乐展台；影像方面，索尼、尼康、松下、宝丽来、适马、斯莫格等厂商共同构建全链路影像体验；TCL华星将携联想、AGON爱攻、EVNIA弈威、华硕、LG、MSI、Acer、BenQ、TCL、索尼、雷鸟等终端品牌伙伴，以APEX臻图为纽带，为全球游戏玩家开启一场游戏生态的显示产品盛宴；比亚迪则带来智能座舱与新能源技术创新；淘天潮玩、Hot Toys、MOSHOWTOYS、threezero、INART、卡游、天闻角川、大漫匠、JOYTOY、Prime 1 Studio等众多品牌携热门产品亮相；老凤祥、得力、璞隐酒店等企业参展；AULUMU奥鲁姆、OUROPROXY EDC、01、GD、PEL、BPMODS EDC、推乐TWILA、小芒、KADA EDC、极速沸腾等品牌齐聚UGA极致装备展区，引领高端解压消费新潮流。

首设官方主舞台及多个创新展区，内容科技双轮驱动
本届首设ChinaJoy官方主舞台，英特尔大师挑战赛总决赛将落地引爆赛事热情。全新增设Vision Future前沿科技展区，集中展示智能机器人、AI大模型、智能穿戴等新技术；ChinaJoy Next Play创新游戏体验场提供AI NPC、互动叙事、生成式内容等前沿产品试玩，打造AI与游戏深度融合的实验场景；影像科技×二次元文化专属展区打通“采集、处理、输出”全产业链；UGA极致装备EDC PARK展区以高端解压玩具链接Z世代高净值群体。多项首创举措有力凸显“内容+科技”双轮驱动战略。
国际化再度提升，打造全球化数码娱乐产业中枢
本届展会汇聚了三十余个国家和地区的企业参展，预计海外专业观众将达万人次，打造联通全球的产业合作桥头堡。俄罗斯、韩国、西班牙、波兰、菲律宾、日本等国家，以及中国香港地区的展团悉数参展，规模近900平方米。ChinaJoy将持续完善双向赋能、多层链接的国际化生态，发挥国际一流产业融合平台作用，助力数字娱乐产业跃迁升级。
重磅合作，强强联手，共筑价值高地
中国国际数码互动娱乐展览会（ChinaJoy）与徐悲鸿美术馆达成战略合作，2026马年将以展会为平台，推动艺术与科技跨界融合，让经典IP与数字产业碰撞火花，树立文化自信与产业创新融合的新标杆。7月29日至8月3日，“2026 ChinaJoy Game Show” 专题页将再次登陆蒸汽平台与Steam双平台首页，阵容全面升级，精选全球头部游戏厂商与独立开发者重磅产品，打造数字世界“第二展馆”，实现“线下盛会、线上联动”的全球立体化呈现。抖音直播在今年面向泛语音主播首次推出平台级赛事——“声浪狂欢季”，吸引语音聊天室、虚拟、电台三大场景主播参与。作为“ChinaJoy官方内容合作平台”与“ChinaJoy官方直播合作平台”，抖音直播将投入流量资源，打造专属主题展区，邀请“声浪狂欢季”优胜主播及特邀嘉宾空降现场，并带来精彩Live演出及现场互动；支付宝“碰一下”联合展会带来全新近场交互体验，首发“碰一下组队”与“积分膨胀”玩法，并重磅推出内置nft芯片的“碰一下实物票根”系列周边。入场观众手机轻碰票根，即可解锁专属数字藏品和展会核心服务，同时获取地图、展商信息、展会日程、主线打卡
四大服务。“碰一下”相关服务将于7月初逐步上线，现场特设专属互动体验区；淘宝天猫潮玩首度携手ChinaJoy独家推出“2026 ChinaJoy云逛展”线上会场，汇聚手办机甲、IP衍生品等热卖商品，实现观展选购一站式体验；快手与ChinaJoy达成深度合作，投入亿级流量扶持，邀约cosplay、电竞等领域头部KOL，打造漫展Coser大闯关大型直播等玩法。合作身份为官方内容合作平台及深度合作媒体。京东美妆成为2026
ChinaJoy美妆战略合作伙伴，共建“ChinaJoy× 京东美妆嘉年华”IP，贯通内容—产品—消费全链路，深耕年轻化美妆细分赛道。
次元共振，直击年轻群体娱乐新需求
2026 ChinaJoy携手幻音文化、三角喵文化推出两场主题演唱会。8月1日，在虹口区星临天下（滨港商业中心店）举办AniSonic星尘十周年演唱会，围绕播放量破亿的虚拟歌姬星尘打造，演出时长约120分钟，设置沉浸式舞台、粉丝共创墙、自由舞台等互动区域，并首发联名周边；8月2日，在瓦肆VAS est推出玄歌国风演唱会，集结国风实力艺人，以古典美学融合多样曲风，呈现视听兼备的国风演出。
展会现场举办Coser自由行活动，邀请游戏、动漫、潮玩、科技等领域头部创作者到场，打造跨次元派对。新设“地下偶像互动区”，推出定制角色外观、展会限定雪糕等衍生品，并与《剑网3》深度合作，实现线上情感连接与线下消费社交的完整闭环。2026年“百达计划”全面升级，通过线上内容预热与线下深度互动双轮驱动，为参展商创造亿级品牌曝光。
助力新生代人才发展，推动创新技术落地
发挥ChinaJoy产业平台作用，扶持新生代专业人才发展，举办第六届中国游戏创新大赛展览展示，共征集204款游戏作品，参赛主体覆盖全国19个省份及直辖市、6个海外国家，其中上海作品申报占比20%。本届展会全新设置ChinaJoy AGS学院游戏展区，构建起一个公益性、专业化、国际化的高校创作展示平台。由世纪华通发起的第二届数龙杯全球AI创新大赛相关活动将亮相2026 ChinaJoy AI未来生态大会。本次还将携手405游局，全新推出ChinaJoy Next Play创新游戏体验场展区，集中呈现AI游戏与互动娱乐最新探索成果，涵盖AI NPC、互动叙事、生成式内容等多元形态。
同期大会紧扣行业脉搏，锚定产业增长风口
2026年ChinaJoy系列峰会紧扣“AI驱动数字内容创作”的行业脉搏，以“全新增长”与“技术破圈”为核心，共设6大行业峰会，构建覆盖游戏、AI生态、数字消费场景及全球化布局的顶级产业交流平台；首设“数字娱乐消费场景峰会”，重构线下娱乐空间的人货场连接，聚焦“生态协同与价值共创、场景变现与长效运营、跨界融合与生态共建”三大维度，探讨沉浸式硬件与线下内容融合、数字孪生赋能实体娱乐场景及会员经济创新，推动数字娱乐产业从线上产品交易向“硬件+内容+空间+运营”的实体生态化转型；新增“短剧创新论坛”，以“剧AI·让每一帧都是世界语言”为主题，解析AI技术如何推动短剧从流量竞争走向精品提质，助力企业打破地域文化壁垒，打造全球影响力爆款。
潮流文化融合，打响上海本土品牌
2026年ChinaJoy全面升级上海知名品牌展区，采用老上海石库门特色设计，打造复古与潮流兼具的沉浸式展示空间。雷允上、美加净等经典老字号悉数参展，多家品牌推出展会专属联名产品，实现国货与数字娱乐跨界创新。展区内设国家非遗体验区，搭配打卡互动等多元体验，拉近青年群体与传统文化、本土品牌的距离，提升海派文化传播力与上海国潮影响力。
智慧化服务升级全面提升观展体验
展会从后台系统、商务配对、现场服务三大维度升级：完善私域运营信息服务，升级商务配对系统并为配对成功主体开放专业观众证件申领权限。联合科大讯飞在BTOB展区部署智能翻译设备，支持多语种实时互译与转写，满足跨境洽谈需求。优化展位编码与地标指引，设立自助取证区，提升入场效率。优化玩家入场线路，实时动态调整线路规划，主打少走路，进一步关注玩家逛展舒适度；本次升级CJ Arena玩法，推出官方集卡积分活动，组队可赚取成倍积分抽取周边，提升逛展互动乐趣。本次ChinaJoy官方特别联合了外骨骼机器人行业头部企业傲鲨智能，共同打造了逛展新体验，现场观众可以在展会现场亲身感受外骨骼黑科技，体验赛博逛展。
“上海之夏”全城联动 助燃消费热潮
ChinaJoy围绕“上海之夏”国际消费季，联合浦东新区推动陆家嘴、世博、前滩等商圈与展会联动，推出专属票根权益，将年轻观众引导至商圈，提升区域知名度与品牌辐射力。延续展会效应，推出浦东第二届“谷子嘉年华”，联动多商圈打造文化、娱乐、消费一体的二次元盛会。
2026 ChinaJoy早鸟票即将开抢
本届ChinaJoy门票分三轮依次开售，各时段安排如下：
7月8日：超级早鸟票开售
7月9日：早鸟票开售
7月10日：正式全面开票
国内观众可在大麦、CJ魔方官方微信小程序、B站会员购、支付宝蓝花火、票星球、携程、秀动于开票前一周在以上任意官方指定平台，搜索「ChinaJoy」预约抢票；海外观众可通过MaiSeat平台购票。

本届展会汇聚了三十余个国家和地区的企业参展，预计海外专业观众将达万人次，打造联通全球的产业合作桥头堡。俄罗斯、韩国、西班牙、波兰、菲律宾、日本等国家，以及中国香港地区的展团悉数参展，规模近900平方米。ChinaJoy将持续完善双向赋能、多层链接的国际化生态，发挥国际一流产业融合平台作用，助力数字娱乐产业跃迁升级。


重磅合作，强强联手，共筑价值高地

中国国际数码互动娱乐展览会（ChinaJoy）与徐悲鸿美术馆达成战略合作，2026马年将以展会为平台，推动艺术与科技跨界融合，让经典IP与数字产业碰撞火花，树立文化自信与产业创新融合的新标杆。7月29日至8月3日，“2026 ChinaJoy Game Show” 专题页将再次登陆蒸汽平台与Steam双平台首页，阵容全面升级，精选全球头部游戏厂商与独立开发者重磅产品，打造数字世界“第二展馆”，实现“线下盛会、线上联动”的全球立体化呈现。抖音直播在今年面向泛语音主播首次推出平台级赛事——“声浪狂欢季”，吸引语音聊天室、虚拟、电台三大场景主播参与。作为“ChinaJoy官方内容合作平台”与“ChinaJoy官方直播合作平台”，抖音直播将投入流量资源，打造专属主题展区，邀请“声浪狂欢季”优胜主播及特邀嘉宾空降现场，并带来精彩Live演出及现场互动；支付宝“碰一下”联合展会带来全新近场交互体验，首发“碰一下组队”与“积分膨胀”玩法，并重磅推出内置nft芯片的“碰一下实物票根”系列周边。入场观众手机轻碰票根，即可解锁专属数字藏品和展会核心服务，同时获取地图、展商信息、展会日程、主线打卡 四大服务。“碰一下”相关服务将于7月初逐步上线，现场特设专属互动体验区；淘宝天猫潮玩首度携手ChinaJoy独家推出“2026 ChinaJoy云逛展”线上会场，汇聚手办机甲、IP衍生品等热卖商品，实现观展选购一站式体验；快手与ChinaJoy达成深度合作，投入亿级流量扶持，邀约cosplay、电竞等领域头部KOL，打造漫展Coser大闯关大型直播等玩法。合作身份为官方内容合作平台及深度合作媒体。京东美妆成为2026 ChinaJoy美妆战略合作伙伴，共建“ChinaJoy× 京东美妆嘉年华”IP，贯通内容—产品—消费全链路，深耕年轻化美妆细分赛道。


次元共振，直击年轻群体娱乐新需求

2026 ChinaJoy携手幻音文化、三角喵文化推出两场主题演唱会。8月1日，在虹口区星临天下（滨港商业中心店）举办AniSonic星尘十周年演唱会，围绕播放量破亿的虚拟歌姬星尘打造，演出时长约120分钟，设置沉浸式舞台、粉丝共创墙、自由舞台等互动区域，并首发联名周边；8月2日，在瓦肆VAS est推出玄歌国风演唱会，集结国风实力艺人，以古典美学融合多样曲风，呈现视听兼备的国风演出。

展会现场举办Coser自由行活动，邀请游戏、动漫、潮玩、科技等领域头部创作者到场，打造跨次元派对。新设“地下偶像互动区”，推出定制角色外观、展会限定雪糕等衍生品，并与《剑网3》深度合作，实现线上情感连接与线下消费社交的完整闭环。2026年“百达计划”全面升级，通过线上内容预热与线下深度互动双轮驱动，为参展商创造亿级品牌曝光。


助力新生代人才发展，推动创新技术落地

发挥ChinaJoy产业平台作用，扶持新生代专业人才发展，举办第六届中国游戏创新大赛展览展示，共征集204款游戏作品，参赛主体覆盖全国19个省份及直辖市、6个海外国家，其中上海作品申报占比20%。本届展会全新设置ChinaJoy AGS学院游戏展区，构建起一个公益性、专业化、国际化的高校创作展示平台。由世纪华通发起的第二届数龙杯全球AI创新大赛相关活动将亮相2026 ChinaJoy AI未来生态大会。本次还将携手405游局，全新推出ChinaJoy Next Play创新游戏体验场展区，集中呈现AI游戏与互动娱乐最新探索成果，涵盖AI NPC、互动叙事、生成式内容等多元形态。


同期大会紧扣行业脉搏，锚定产业增长风口

2026年ChinaJoy系列峰会紧扣“AI驱动数字内容创作”的行业脉搏，以“全新增长”与“技术破圈”为核心，共设6大行业峰会，构建覆盖游戏、AI生态、数字消费场景及全球化布局的顶级产业交流平台；首设“数字娱乐消费场景峰会”，重构线下娱乐空间的人货场连接，聚焦“生态协同与价值共创、场景变现与长效运营、跨界融合与生态共建”三大维度，探讨沉浸式硬件与线下内容融合、数字孪生赋能实体娱乐场景及会员经济创新，推动数字娱乐产业从线上产品交易向“硬件+内容+空间+运营”的实体生态化转型；新增“短剧创新论坛”，以“剧AI·让每一帧都是世界语言”为主题，解析AI技术如何推动短剧从流量竞争走向精品提质，助力企业打破地域文化壁垒，打造全球影响力爆款。


潮流文化融合，打响上海本土品牌

2026年ChinaJoy全面升级上海知名品牌展区，采用老上海石库门特色设计，打造复古与潮流兼具的沉浸式展示空间。雷允上、美加净等经典老字号悉数参展，多家品牌推出展会专属联名产品，实现国货与数字娱乐跨界创新。展区内设国家非遗体验区，搭配打卡互动等多元体验，拉近青年群体与传统文化、本土品牌的距离，提升海派文化传播力与上海国潮影响力。


智慧化服务升级全面提升观展体验

展会从后台系统、商务配对、现场服务三大维度升级：完善私域运营信息服务，升级商务配对系统并为配对成功主体开放专业观众证件申领权限。联合科大讯飞在BTOB展区部署智能翻译设备，支持多语种实时互译与转写，满足跨境洽谈需求。优化展位编码与地标指引，设立自助取证区，提升入场效率。优化玩家入场线路，实时动态调整线路规划，主打少走路，进一步关注玩家逛展舒适度；本次升级CJ Arena玩法，推出官方集卡积分活动，组队可赚取成倍积分抽取周边，提升逛展互动乐趣。本次ChinaJoy官方特别联合了外骨骼机器人行业头部企业傲鲨智能，共同打造了逛展新体验，现场观众可以在展会现场亲身感受外骨骼黑科技，体验赛博逛展。


“上海之夏”全城联动 助燃消费热潮

ChinaJoy围绕“上海之夏”国际消费季，联合浦东新区推动陆家嘴、世博、前滩等商圈与展会联动，推出专属票根权益，将年轻观众引导至商圈，提升区域知名度与品牌辐射力。延续展会效应，推出浦东第二届“谷子嘉年华”，联动多商圈打造文化、娱乐、消费一体的二次元盛会。


2026 ChinaJoy早鸟票即将开抢

本届ChinaJoy门票分三轮依次开售，各时段安排如下：

7月8日：超级早鸟票开售

7月9日：早鸟票开售

title: 登上畅销榜！4399再战女性向，这款种花新游能成吗
text:
登上畅销榜！4399再战女性向，这款种花新游能成吗
游戏新知君
2026-06-26 18:20 发布于 湖北 游戏新知官方账号
关注
下载客户端看更多
题图 | 《童话师》
作者 | 落日飞车
又一款种花新游来了。
最近，由4399发行的女性向经营游戏《童话师》开启全平台公测。该产品早先便因清新的手绘画风及类极繁主义的装修风格积累了一定热度，TapTap关注数超过43万。正式上线后，游戏连续6天位居iOS免费榜前十、畅销榜TOP150，并于昨日 （6月25日） 开始进入微信小游戏畅销榜TOP100。
这当然不是4399首次尝试女性向产品。比如模拟经营游戏，公司就发行过不少款，它们各有各的卖点，像《时光镇》主打休闲种田+小镇经营，《纸萌猫乐园》体验古代茶馆掌柜的日常，《某某朝的女子乐坊》的唐风女团题材则令人感到新鲜……
4399也早早盯上了合成品类。前几年把国内蛮火的微信小游戏《改装大作战》带到海外，以「吃瓜」「情感冲突」为噱头，试图撬动日韩等市场；又上架了动物题材的《萌宠时代》，从「救猫」角度出发，对二合玩法进行包装。
看得出4399一直在小步试探，想看看有没有爆的可能性。但比较可惜，这些产品总差那么一口气，成绩应该没达到公司预期。如今它又掏出了一款融合了种花和装修玩法的《童话师》，瞄准的是当下火热的种花细分品类，而这回能成吗？
4399选中的《童话师》并非出自无名之辈。
公开信息显示，《童话师》的开发商是佛山时尚都市网络。这个名字听起来挺陌生，但其实团队很早就做过女性向游戏了。其前身是1999年成立的Flash门户网站 （flash8） ，当年在国内相当有名，聚集了一群动漫爱好者、网页设计师。后来团队从上海搬迁到了广东佛山，成立新主体，开始做起了游戏。
这家公司也比较幸运，早年成功搭上QQ的顺风车，旗下多款休闲游戏在QQ空间走红，圈了一大波休闲党和女性玩家。
其中，与腾讯合作的装扮游戏《时尚都市》，于2011年9月上线QQ空间，次年运营收入突破1000万元。由于表现不错，游戏还被冠上「QQ」之名 （《QQ时尚都市》） ，成了腾讯应用平台上首个冠名QQ的第三方应用。游戏的寿命也蛮长，这么多年过去了还在运营。
不过在QQ红利消退之后，团队很长一段时间没有拿得出手的产品。好在近年来，靠女性向游戏在移动端又有了些水花。2023年推出了《梦幻的城》，上线前预约量便已突破百万，iOS和Google Play累计收入超过8000万元 （数据参考自SensorTower） 。
这也是一款走小清新路线的模拟经营游戏。玩家作为城主，从一个废城建筑起步，推平全部地图，一步步搭建整座动物城。一众造型别致的小动物居民、较高自由度的装修玩法，在当时颇受好评。尤其是装修玩法，游戏里内置了非常多的装饰元件，一眼望去，屏幕常常被塞得满满当当。据透露，主城设计了11000个格子，动物居民有500个，每个造型有5套以上动画，还有大量不同风格的花草树木、门窗砖墙、房屋家具……素材一直加，加到包体「从900M增加到4个G」。
这次，团队新作《童话师》同样以装修为核心玩法之一，并且依旧主打一个量大管饱。但《童话师》不像《梦幻的城》一上来就直接开始装修，而是从种花切入，完整呈现「种花→收获→完成订单→升级→再投资」的循环流程，简单来说，就是通过种花积攒资源，再解锁各式装扮，进而装修建造家园。
先说说种花玩法，机制有点类似《我的花园世界》，整个环节同样塞入了不少内容，靠任务链条不停推动玩家做任务来推进进程。就这么把本该休闲松弛的花园玩法，硬是做成了让人轻松不起来的游戏体验。
游戏里设计了非常丰富的鲜花种类，刚开始你可能还有心情去欣赏它们，但很快你将受困于繁琐的操作之中 （也让月卡提供的各类一键操作显得格外诱人了） 。
比如收花之前，你得经历培育花种、开垦荒地、播种、浇水等多个步骤。鲜花还划分了不同品级 （B、A、S、SR、SSR） ，根据品级差异，它们的售价、获取途径、培育耗时、产出数量、花期时长等都不同。鲜花还有独立的养成进阶体系，同种鲜花要不断升级才能提升属性。凑齐花材之后也不能直接制作家具，要先绘制家具设计图纸。
而完成上述操作的过程中都可能要消耗资源。缩短培育、种植时长分别要消耗星钻、水滴，绘制家具图纸则要消耗紫币和颜料。
游戏前期会赠送大量资源，从而大幅压缩了等待时间，游玩体验也较为顺畅。但进入中后期，资源缺口会急剧扩大，培育一个花种、绘制一张图纸可能就要消耗大笔资源，升级门槛大幅抬高，进度很容易卡住，不付费就很难推进。
也因此，游戏遭到不少玩家吐槽「又肝又氪」，每天两眼一睁就是点点点，不付费的话，只能挤出碎片时间重复地种花、收花、交订单。当然这其实也不稀奇，许多模拟经营游戏都普遍存在此类争议。
在体验了种花流程后，紧接着玩家会进入到装修环节。在上线前，《童话师》的「极繁主义」就引起了建造党的关注，其中一款苹果造型的屋子引来不少玩家入坑。游戏整体采用相对细腻的卡通手绘风，再结合偏淡雅的配色，予人一种「童话镇」的既视感。虽然风格略显单一，画面放大后线条略显粗糙，但美术在同类游戏里已经算是中上水平了。
图源：社交平台
从体验上来看，其装修玩法的自由度确实比较高，也是本作的最大亮点。
室内和户外造景的可选项很多，范围也广。往大了说有绿植 （花草树木） 、城景 （交通工具、公共设施、建筑、喷泉等） 、基建 （路、砖、桥、围栏、楼梯等） ，以及各式各样的家具 （坐具、床、桌台、卫浴等） ，甚至连墙面、墙体、门窗、壁纸都可以进行改造。往小了说，交通工具有手拉车、自行车、跑车，坐具就有凳子、椅子、沙发和秋千，桌台则区分学习、吃饭、做饭、梳妆等不同使用场景进行设计。
游戏的建造细节也是一大加分项。最广受好评的就有：家具支持无限复制，每个家具解锁之后就可以无限数量添加；同时，家具不仅可以四面旋转，部分组合家具还可以拆分，举个例子，如果你觉得某套餐桌的果盘很漂亮，你可以单独移动果盘放到你喜欢的位置；再有，墙饰、瓷砖、地势等都支持叠放，你可以将三类元件自由堆叠组合……
房屋结构层面也相对自由，墙体、地板、屋顶都能扩展或收缩，还能加盖二楼。比方说，你完全可以在二楼用水池元件挖一个豪华泳池，实现「梦中情房」，对了，水池里还能养鱼。
令人意外的是，游戏里还有光影系统。关键它还不是随便加个滤镜敷衍了事，而是能看出有切实考虑到玩家对打光的需求。照明灯具有壁灯、路灯、台灯、吊灯……全都可以自行设置开关、调整明暗和色调，为了更具真实感，还添加了地影、光源、夜景的选项，甚至连光源的形状、大小、颜色都能自定义。夜景一开，灯一亮，氛围感直接拉满。甚至有玩家直接手搓各种梦幻光影。
图源：社交平台
整个装修环节真的像在建造一个家。更微妙的是，玩家还能点击操控游戏里的小人，让她在地图上走来走去，跟家具产生互动，莫名又有种在微缩世界养「小人」的感觉了。市面上的模拟经营手游很多，但说实话能把装修自由度做到这个程度的，并不多见。
其实不止是4399，最近一年许多厂商都盯上了女性向细分品类。事实证明，至少在国内，能冲击榜单头部的并非只有《恋与深空》这类纯恋爱题材，像《我的花园世界》《时尚百货城》这类以女性玩家为主但对泛用户同样友好的产品，同样具备惊人的号召力。尤其是种花题材，相关产品长期霸占小游戏畅销榜前三，甚至多次拿下榜首的位置，自然也吸引了不少团队跟风入局。
像三七互娱的《织梦森林》，便长期保持在微信畅销榜TOP70。友谊时光在今年上线了《花与绯想》，据称月流水也有千万量级。 深圳天苻科技继《秘密花园HD》 《花札物语》取得一定成绩之后，又上线了《解忧花店》。名臣健康也出了款花园like新游《魔幻花城》，并打出「玩游戏送真花」的旗号。另有湖南团队出品的《喵与花集》，以动物主题进行包装，最近冲到了抖音新游榜TOP5……
种花游戏的赛道肉眼可见地渐渐拥挤起来。这阵子4399加大了《童话师》的投放力度，游戏在iOS端的成绩不算突出，但在小程序上倒是有冒头的迹象，说不定能从小游戏这边撕开一个口子。
/   END   /

html:
登上畅销榜！4399再战女性向，这款种花新游能成吗

游戏新知君

2026-06-26 18:20发布于湖北游戏新知官方账号

关注
下载客户端看更多

题图 | 《童话师》

作者 | 落日飞车


又一款种花新游来了。


最近，由4399发行的女性向经营游戏《童话师》开启全平台公测。该产品早先便因清新的手绘画风及类极繁主义的装修风格积累了一定热度，TapTap关注数超过43万。正式上线后，游戏连续6天位居iOS免费榜前十、畅销榜TOP150，并于昨日（6月25日）开始进入微信小游戏畅销榜TOP100。



这当然不是4399首次尝试女性向产品。比如模拟经营游戏，公司就发行过不少款，它们各有各的卖点，像《时光镇》主打休闲种田+小镇经营，《纸萌猫乐园》体验古代茶馆掌柜的日常，《某某朝的女子乐坊》的唐风女团题材则令人感到新鲜……


4399也早早盯上了合成品类。前几年把国内蛮火的微信小游戏《改装大作战》带到海外，以「吃瓜」「情感冲突」为噱头，试图撬动日韩等市场；又上架了动物题材的《萌宠时代》，从「救猫」角度出发，对二合玩法进行包装。 


看得出4399一直在小步试探，想看看有没有爆的可能性。但比较可惜，这些产品总差那么一口气，成绩应该没达到公司预期。如今它又掏出了一款融合了种花和装修玩法的《童话师》，瞄准的是当下火热的种花细分品类，而这回能成吗？


4399选中的《童话师》并非出自无名之辈。


公开信息显示，《童话师》的开发商是佛山时尚都市网络。这个名字听起来挺陌生，但其实团队很早就做过女性向游戏了。其前身是1999年成立的Flash门户网站（flash8），当年在国内相当有名，聚集了一群动漫爱好者、网页设计师。后来团队从上海搬迁到了广东佛山，成立新主体，开始做起了游戏。


这家公司也比较幸运，早年成功搭上QQ的顺风车，旗下多款休闲游戏在QQ空间走红，圈了一大波休闲党和女性玩家。


其中，与腾讯合作的装扮游戏《时尚都市》，于2011年9月上线QQ空间，次年运营收入突破1000万元。由于表现不错，游戏还被冠上「QQ」之名（《QQ时尚都市》），成了腾讯应用平台上首个冠名QQ的第三方应用。游戏的寿命也蛮长，这么多年过去了还在运营。



不过在QQ红利消退之后，团队很长一段时间没有拿得出手的产品。好在近年来，靠女性向游戏在移动端又有了些水花。2023年推出了《梦幻的城》，上线前预约量便已突破百万，iOS和Google Play累计收入超过8000万元（数据参考自SensorTower）。



这也是一款走小清新路线的模拟经营游戏。玩家作为城主，从一个废城建筑起步，推平全部地图，一步步搭建整座动物城。一众造型别致的小动物居民、较高自由度的装修玩法，在当时颇受好评。尤其是装修玩法，游戏里内置了非常多的装饰元件，一眼望去，屏幕常常被塞得满满当当。据透露，主城设计了11000个格子，动物居民有500个，每个造型有5套以上动画，还有大量不同风格的花草树木、门窗砖墙、房屋家具……素材一直加，加到包体「从900M增加到4个G」。



这次，团队新作《童话师》同样以装修为核心玩法之一，并且依旧主打一个量大管饱。但《童话师》不像《梦幻的城》一上来就直接开始装修，而是从种花切入，完整呈现「种花→收获→完成订单→升级→再投资」的循环流程，简单来说，就是通过种花积攒资源，再解锁各式装扮，进而装修建造家园。



先说说种花玩法，机制有点类似《我的花园世界》，整个环节同样塞入了不少内容，靠任务链条不停推动玩家做任务来推进进程。就这么把本该休闲松弛的花园玩法，硬是做成了让人轻松不起来的游戏体验。


游戏里设计了非常丰富的鲜花种类，刚开始你可能还有心情去欣赏它们，但很快你将受困于繁琐的操作之中（也让月卡提供的各类一键操作显得格外诱人了）。



比如收花之前，你得经历培育花种、开垦荒地、播种、浇水等多个步骤。鲜花还划分了不同品级（B、A、S、SR、SSR），根据品级差异，它们的售价、获取途径、培育耗时、产出数量、花期时长等都不同。鲜花还有独立的养成进阶体系，同种鲜花要不断升级才能提升属性。凑齐花材之后也不能直接制作家具，要先绘制家具设计图纸。


而完成上述操作的过程中都可能要消耗资源。缩短培育、种植时长分别要消耗星钻、水滴，绘制家具图纸则要消耗紫币和颜料。


游戏前期会赠送大量资源，从而大幅压缩了等待时间，游玩体验也较为顺畅。但进入中后期，资源缺口会急剧扩大，培育一个花种、绘制一张图纸可能就要消耗大笔资源，升级门槛大幅抬高，进度很容易卡住，不付费就很难推进。


也因此，游戏遭到不少玩家吐槽「又肝又氪」，每天两眼一睁就是点点点，不付费的话，只能挤出碎片时间重复地种花、收花、交订单。当然这其实也不稀奇，许多模拟经营游戏都普遍存在此类争议。


在体验了种花流程后，紧接着玩家会进入到装修环节。在上线前，《童话师》的「极繁主义」就引起了建造党的关注，其中一款苹果造型的屋子引来不少玩家入坑。游戏整体采用相对细腻的卡通手绘风，再结合偏淡雅的配色，予人一种「童话镇」的既视感。虽然风格略显单一，画面放大后线条略显粗糙，但美术在同类游戏里已经算是中上水平了。


图源：社交平台


从体验上来看，其装修玩法的自由度确实比较高，也是本作的最大亮点。


室内和户外造景的可选项很多，范围也广。往大了说有绿植（花草树木）、城景（交通工具、公共设施、建筑、喷泉等）、基建（路、砖、桥、围栏、楼梯等），以及各式各样的家具（坐具、床、桌台、卫浴等），甚至连墙面、墙体、门窗、壁纸都可以进行改造。往小了说，交通工具有手拉车、自行车、跑车，坐具就有凳子、椅子、沙发和秋千，桌台则区分学习、吃饭、做饭、梳妆等不同使用场景进行设计。



游戏的建造细节也是一大加分项。最广受好评的就有：家具支持无限复制，每个家具解锁之后就可以无限数量添加；同时，家具不仅可以四面旋转，部分组合家具还可以拆分，举个例子，如果你觉得某套餐桌的果盘很漂亮，你可以单独移动果盘放到你喜欢的位置；再有，墙饰、瓷砖、地势等都支持叠放，你可以将三类元件自由堆叠组合……



房屋结构层面也相对自由，墙体、地板、屋顶都能扩展或收缩，还能加盖二楼。比方说，你完全可以在二楼用水池元件挖一个豪华泳池，实现「梦中情房」，对了，水池里还能养鱼。

title: "Mission Impossible is high on my list" – how Paramount plans to use co-dev to exploit its archive, while building its own all-new IP
author: Jon Hicks
excerpt:
Just before Summer Games Fest kicked off, Paramount Skydance announced it was merging its video games divisions into a new entity called Paramount Games Studio.
Read more
text:
Just before Summer Games Fest kicked off, Paramount Skydance announced it was merging its video games divisions into a new entity called Paramount Games Studio.
The venture brings Skydance's studios – Skydance Interactive and Skydance New Media – under the same umbrella as Paramount's IP. The 170-strong outfit is helmed by EVP and head of games, Dan Prigg, who previously worked at Scopely and Aspyr Media before joining Skydance Interactive in 2022 as EVP and head of studio. He tells GamesIndustry.biz that the new organisation is the most sensible way to serve the company's purposes.
Dan Prigg | Image credit: Paramount Games Studio
"Paramount, prior to the merger, was just licensing," he explains. "They weren't doing any internal development. They weren't really doing much in terms of co-development and publishing. Skydance had a couple of studios, and we had licensing on our own." The newly united business "looked at the whole thing holistically" and concluded the sensible option was "one division that can help control the slate, help with the brands, really build the communities."
The new division was born with several titles already in development, including the Marvel 1943 title that Amy Hennig has been working on for some time , an unspecified Star Wars title from the same studio, and the externally-developed Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game. At SGF the firm announced a Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles game from hack-and-slash specialists PlatinumGames and Star Trek: Shadow Frontier, a horror romp from genre specialists BlooberTeam. It's looking to sign more, chiefly through co-development because "we have more IP than we have actual capacity," says Prigg.
Finding co-development partners
In terms of picking developers to work on projects, Prigg says Paramount has a pretty simple philosophy: "right IP, right team, right size," with the latter referring to both the scope of the game and the size of the team that makes it. "We don't necessarily want to do some sort of massive AAA IP that may not make sense for the IP," he says. "With Platinum, we got a great triple-A studio that is passionate about our IP and that's what we want to find, from a studio perspective."
Related
Analyst: Q1 2026 revenue figures show there is still demand for compelling single-player video games
Q1 marks seventh consecutive quarter of revenue growth, says S&P Global Market Intelligence, with Capcom and Pearl Abyss showing strong results
Other brands may get smaller games, if the the right partner can be found. "It's going to be a combination," says Prigg. "A double-A title is going to feel just as good as a triple-A title if you do it right. I don't want to break myself into jail by saying it always has to be AAA, because then the smaller studios who might do something amazing for us aren't going to try."
"I don't want to say it always has to be AAA, because then the smaller studios who might do something amazing for us aren't going to try"
"I think we're always going to be looking at pitches, and I don't want to be saying 'we'll only use these kinds of studios.' I want the best studios to rise up," he says, admitting that he knows this is opening him up to a deluge of inbound pitches. "It's about finding the best partner that makes sense, who could really bring out the IP for us– whether they are internal, co-development or licensing."
It's not looking purely at PC and console, either. The company already has a presence in Roblox with titles such as SpongeBob Squarepants and TMNT: Battle Tycoon, and outreach that Prigg says will continue. "We want to be where the fans are," he says, "and Gen Alpha, this is where they're participating." It's also "actively looking at" mobile, with a view to building on successful partnerships with Scopley and FunPlus.
Related
Roblox partners with SuperAwesome to bring "brand safe advertising" to under-13s
"Together, we have the opportunity to help brands engage with kids and tweens responsibly and transparently"
"We're trying to make games for all generations," says Prigg. "That's the hard part – it's not just four quadrants, it's 4D quadrants. We have so much IP across so many different generations that it's hard to keep track of it all and see what makes sense, but that's the fun part.
"There's kids who may have never heard of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles… or there might be that Gen X that hadn't thought of Turtles in 20 years. For us, it's really about the exposure: if we continue to build a brand, maybe then they want to see the TV show or the movie or an animation. That's where we want to make sure that we're doing our part from a games perspective, to do the best representation."
A huge IP archive
There is no shortage of IP to choose from, with decades of film and TV brands waiting to be exploited. "Mission Impossible is still high on my list," says Prigg. "Star Trek is a big perennial. That's a big one for us and it's very loved. Franchises like SpongeBob and Avatar are big ones. The Nick games themselves are huge. We want to bring those back to a certain degree, asking how we could continue to build those brands."
The team is not rushing into any given IP, though, because "trying to find a studio for an IP, you usually find the wrong studio," he says. "We'll keep looking at game ideas, but it has to be right. We can't force it and put it on a roadmap to be done by this date and it's going to be this sort of game. That just feels like putting the cart before the horse."
Star Trek: Shadow Frontier began as a licenced title which Paramount opted to co-develop and publish.
This extends, he claims, to not tying a game's schedule to that of the IP that its based on – an approach that previously delivered generations of hastily-developed and usually very poorly-reviewed licenced games that were rushed out to match a film release. Prigg says that Paramount Games Studios' release schedule is its own and not beholden to timing of the wider IP.
"There are ways that we try to work with theatrical, TV, animation and all the groups," he says. "There are opportunities where our job is to continue to build the brand. Our job is to continue just to make great games, but you can't do it if you're under the extra restriction of having to be out by the theatrical release date. The games stand on their own. No one's going to complain about that. If it can coincide, or help fill a gap from a brand perspective by being in between the Ninja Turtle movies, for example, that's a plus to me."
There is a recent highly successful example of this from outside the Paramount stable: IO Interactive's 007 First Light, which has not-entirely-intentionally filled a major gap between James Bond films.
"The IO guys did a great job," Prigg admits. "If you look at that kind of marketing, they almost treat it like a movie release. They're really treating it like: 'Hey, you're not going to get another James Bond film for at least three or four years, but this is going to satisfy that feeling'. It's going to feel like a movie release. And I think that's where great lessons can be learned there of making our games really feel like theatrical releases and have their own identity."
Prigg is keen for Paramount's output to have a similar impact to 007 First Light. | Image credit: IO Interactive
Games that spark movies
Nor is Paramount Games planning to simply exploit the parent company's archives. The company also has a studio working on original properties: Skydance Interactive, who previously shipped VR releases The Walking Dead: Saints and Sinners and 2024's Behemoth. Prigg describes it as a "hyper-talented" team that's no longer VR-focused and has been set on developing entirely new IP for PC and console.
"The intent is like we have this small hyper-focused team with great technology, they're great storytellers, let's do something original that might be super interesting," he says. The goal is for a games team with access to a vast reserve of world-famous intellectual property to launch its own hit – which could then become linear entertainment itself.
"Stories can come from anywhere," says Prigg. "The old flywheel was movies make an IP, and then everyone feeds off of that. I think you're starting to see games are starting to create the IPs and stories, that potentially movies and TV are going to come from."
The Hollywood curse
There is a long history of the film industry seeking to get into the games business, and it has not been a happy one. Various studios including previous iterations of Paramount have all made splashy investments in games and studios only to retreat back to the relatively safe money of licensing when things don't work out . The only Hollywood heavyweight to have found long-term success is Warner, with WB Games making smart investments in things like Lego stalwart TT Games and the Batman titles from Rocksteady. (That group will soon be joining the Paramount organization ; Prigg says it's "definitely looking too far forward" to say how the groups would integrate and he's "just treating my division as a business-as-usual").
"We genuinely believe that games are a medium that is going to be worthy for our audience"
Prigg is aware of Hollywood's chequered history in the games space, and says that this iteration of Paramount is being "pragmatic" and not "overly aggressive" in its approach. "I would say that all the way up to the senior leadership here actually believes in games," he continues. "That's a big differentiator between, say, other media companies where they're mainly in TV and film, and games felt like it was something that they would try and if it didn't work out they'd stop. Here we genuinely believe that games are a medium that is going to be worthy for our audience."
"But I don't want to scale too big or overindex in terms of resources. I don't want to just ramp up and buy a whole bunch of studios for no reason. I want to actually have it come from a plan, and scale from a business perspective."
There are, at least, some recent examples of companies that have made licenced IP work in games, from 007 First Light through to Scopely's Monoply Go!. Paramount, Prigg believes, will find its own way. "I think we're just going to be in a unique place where to a larger degree, we're just going to have to carve out our own space and probably do stuff that no one is doing. I'm okay with that."
html:
Just before Summer Games Fest kicked off, Paramount Skydance announced it was merging its video games divisions into a new entity called Paramount Games Studio.

The venture brings Skydance's studios – Skydance Interactive and Skydance New Media – under the same umbrella as Paramount's IP. The 170-strong outfit is helmed by EVP and head of games, Dan Prigg, who previously worked at Scopely and Aspyr Media before joining Skydance Interactive in 2022 as EVP and head of studio. He tells GamesIndustry.biz that the new organisation is the most sensible way to serve the company's purposes.

"Paramount, prior to the merger, was just licensing," he explains. "They weren't doing any internal development. They weren't really doing much in terms of co-development and publishing. Skydance had a couple of studios, and we had licensing on our own." The newly united business "looked at the whole thing holistically" and concluded the sensible option was "one division that can help control the slate, help with the brands, really build the communities."

The new division was born with several titles already in development, including the Marvel 1943 title that Amy Hennig has been working on for some time, an unspecified Star Wars title from the same studio, and the externally-developed Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game. At SGF the firm announced a Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles game from hack-and-slash specialists PlatinumGames and Star Trek: Shadow Frontier, a horror romp from genre specialists BlooberTeam. It's looking to sign more, chiefly through co-development because "we have more IP than we have actual capacity," says Prigg.

Finding co-development partners

In terms of picking developers to work on projects, Prigg says Paramount has a pretty simple philosophy: "right IP, right team, right size," with the latter referring to both the scope of the game and the size of the team that makes it. "We don't necessarily want to do some sort of massive AAA IP that may not make sense for the IP," he says. "With Platinum, we got a great triple-A studio that is passionate about our IP and that's what we want to find, from a studio perspective."

Related
Analyst: Q1 2026 revenue figures show there is still demand for compelling single-player video games
Q1 marks seventh consecutive quarter of revenue growth, says S&P Global Market Intelligence, with Capcom and Pearl Abyss showing strong results

Other brands may get smaller games, if the the right partner can be found. "It's going to be a combination," says Prigg. "A double-A title is going to feel just as good as a triple-A title if you do it right. I don't want to break myself into jail by saying it always has to be AAA, because then the smaller studios who might do something amazing for us aren't going to try."

"I don't want to say it always has to be AAA, because then the smaller studios who might do something amazing for us aren't going to try"

"I think we're always going to be looking at pitches, and I don't want to be saying 'we'll only use these kinds of studios.' I want the best studios to rise up," he says, admitting that he knows this is opening him up to a deluge of inbound pitches. "It's about finding the best partner that makes sense, who could really bring out the IP for us– whether they are internal, co-development or licensing."

It's not looking purely at PC and console, either. The company already has a presence in Roblox with titles such as SpongeBob Squarepants and TMNT: Battle Tycoon, and outreach that Prigg says will continue. "We want to be where the fans are," he says, "and Gen Alpha, this is where they're participating." It's also "actively looking at" mobile, with a view to building on successful partnerships with Scopley and FunPlus.

Related
Roblox partners with SuperAwesome to bring "brand safe advertising" to under-13s
"Together, we have the opportunity to help brands engage with kids and tweens responsibly and transparently"

"We're trying to make games for all generations," says Prigg. "That's the hard part – it's not just four quadrants, it's 4D quadrants. We have so much IP across so many different generations that it's hard to keep track of it all and see what makes sense, but that's the fun part.

"There's kids who may have never heard of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles… or there might be that Gen X that hadn't thought of Turtles in 20 years. For us, it's really about the exposure: if we continue to build a brand, maybe then they want to see the TV show or the movie or an animation. That's where we want to make sure that we're doing our part from a games perspective, to do the best representation."

A huge IP archive

There is no shortage of IP to choose from, with decades of film and TV brands waiting to be exploited. "Mission Impossible is still high on my list," says Prigg. "Star Trek is a big perennial. That's a big one for us and it's very loved. Franchises like SpongeBob and Avatar are big ones. The Nick games themselves are huge. We want to bring those back to a certain degree, asking how we could continue to build those brands."

The team is not rushing into any given IP, though, because "trying to find a studio for an IP, you usually find the wrong studio," he says. "We'll keep looking at game ideas, but it has to be right. We can't force it and put it on a roadmap to be done by this date and it's going to be this sort of game. That just feels like putting the cart before the horse."

This extends, he claims, to not tying a game's schedule to that of the IP that its based on – an approach that previously delivered generations of hastily-developed and usually very poorly-reviewed licenced games that were rushed out to match a film release. Prigg says that Paramount Games Studios' release schedule is its own and not beholden to timing of the wider IP.

"There are ways that we try to work with theatrical, TV, animation and all the groups," he says. "There are opportunities where our job is to continue to build the brand. Our job is to continue just to make great games, but you can't do it if you're under the extra restriction of having to be out by the theatrical release date. The games stand on their own. No one's going to complain about that. If it can coincide, or help fill a gap from a brand perspective by being in between the Ninja Turtle movies, for example, that's a plus to me."

There is a recent highly successful example of this from outside the Paramount stable: IO Interactive's 007 First Light, which has not-entirely-intentionally filled a major gap between James Bond films.

"The IO guys did a great job," Prigg admits. "If you look at that kind of marketing, they almost treat it like a movie release. They're really treating it like: 'Hey, you're not going to get another James Bond film for at least three or four years, but this is going to satisfy that feeling'. It's going to feel like a movie release. And I think that's where great lessons can be learned there of making our games really feel like theatrical releases and have their own identity."

Games that spark movies

Nor is Paramount Games planning to simply exploit the parent company's archives. The company also has a studio working on original properties: Skydance Interactive, who previously shipped VR releases The Walking Dead: Saints and Sinners and 2024's Behemoth. Prigg describes it as a "hyper-talented" team that's no longer VR-focused and has been set on developing entirely new IP for PC and console.

"The intent is like we have this small hyper-focused team with great technology, they're great storytellers, let's do something original that might be super interesting," he says. The goal is for a games team with access to a vast reserve of world-famous intellectual property to launch its own hit – which could then become linear entertainment itself.

"Stories can come from anywhere," says Prigg. "The old flywheel was movies make an IP, and then everyone feeds off of that. I think you're starting to see games are starting to create the IPs and stories, that potentially movies and TV are going to come from."

The Hollywood curse

There is a long history of the film industry seeking to get into the games business, and it has not been a happy one. Various studios including previous iterations of Paramount have all made splashy investments in games and studios only to retreat back to the relatively safe money of licensing when things don't work out. The only Hollywood heavyweight to have found long-term success is Warner, with WB Games making smart investments in things like Lego stalwart TT Games and the Batman titles from Rocksteady. (That group will soon be joining the Paramount organization; Prigg says it's "definitely looking too far forward" to say how the groups would integrate and he's "just treating my division as a business-as-usual").

"We genuinely believe that games are a medium that is going to be worthy for our audience"

Prigg is aware of Hollywood's chequered history in the games space, and says that this iteration of Paramount is being "pragmatic" and not "overly aggressive" in its approach. "I would say that all the way up to the senior leadership here actually believes in games," he continues. "That's a big differentiator between, say, other media companies where they're mainly in TV and film, and games felt like it was something that they would try and if it didn't work out they'd stop. Here we genuinely believe that games are a medium that is going to be worthy for our audience."

"But I don't want to scale too big or overindex in terms of resources. I don't want to just ramp up and buy a whole bunch of studios for no reason. I want to actually have it come from a plan, and scale from a business perspective."

There are, at least, some recent examples of companies that have made licenced IP work in games, from 007 First Light through to Scopely's Monoply Go!. Paramount, Prigg believes, will find its own way. "I think we're just going to be in a unique place where to a larger degree, we're just going to have to carve out our own space and probably do stuff that no one is doing. I'm okay with that."

title: Microsoft significantly increases Xbox prices worldwide and withdraws 2TB model citing "components crisis"
author: Jon Hicks
excerpt:
Microsoft has announced that it is increasing the price of Xbox worldwide from August 2, blaming increased costs for console storage and memory. The 512 GB models will increase by $100 and the 1TB model will increase by $150; the 2TB variant will be withdrawn. The company did not immediately confirm pricing for non-US markets.
Read more
text:
Microsoft has announced that it is increasing the price of Xbox worldwide from August 2, blaming increased costs for console storage and memory. The 512 GB models will increase by $100 and the 1TB model will increase by $150; the 2TB variant will be withdrawn. The company did not immediately confirm pricing for non-US markets.
Based on current RRP, the prices change as follows:
Xbox Series S 512GB goes from $399.99 to $499.99
Xbox Series S 1TB goes from $449.99 to $599.99
Xbox Series X 1TB Digital goes from $599.99 to $749.99
Xbox Series X 1TB goes from $649.99 to $799.99
In a blog post , the company referred to its previous price increase in October and said that while it had hoped another price increase would not be necessary, "console storage and memory prices have increased by more than 2.5x and we expect another doubling by the fall of 2027. The entire consumer electronics industry is struggling with the current components crisis, but the effects are particularly hard on consoles."
"Unlike phones, computers, speakers, and other consumer devices, consoles are typically not sold at a profit, but instead for less than they cost to make."
In the announcement the company highlighted "programs to make Xbox consoles more accessible", including a buy now, pay later option for purchases through the Microsoft Store, interest free financing through Amazon, and "working with retail partners on new programs to provide previously played consoles at lower prices." It also pointed out that "Certified Refurbished Consoles are available at Microsoft Stores for up to US$100 off MSRP."
The news follows this week's announcement that Valve's Steam Machine would be priced higher than the company planned at $1,049 for the 512GB model .

title: Sony cuts 292 jobs at Destiny maker Bungie
author: Alex Forbes-Calvin
excerpt:
Sony Interactive Entertainment is cutting jobs at Destiny maker Bungie.
Read more
text:
Sony Interactive Entertainment is cutting jobs at Destiny maker Bungie.
In an internal email, published to the PlayStation firm's website , Studio Business Group CEO Hermen Hulst said that a "significant number" of staff are affected by this news, including "most of the Destiny team" as well as "some Marathon team members".
To be specific, 292 staff are being let go, according to a WARN filing with Washington State's Employment Security Department.
In addition to Bungie staff being let go, Hulst said that some Sony Interactive Entertainment staff who supported the studio have been made redundant.
"This is painful news, especially for talented colleagues whose roles have been eliminated," Hulst wrote. "This decision was made only after extensive discussion and careful consideration, and I want to provide some context on how we arrived here. Over the past several months, together with Bungie leadership, we reviewed the studio’s long-term direction, development priorities, resource needs, and role within our broader portfolio strategy. We explored multiple alternatives before concluding that a reduction was necessary to align the studio’s resources with its current priorities and long-term goals."
Bungie had already announced that it was closing development on Destiny 2; Hulst described the studio's work on the sci-fi shooter franchise as "truly remarkable". He added that Marathon "remains an important part of our portfolio" and that Sony will support Bungie's continued work on the extraction shooter as well as future projects that are seemingly in the early stages.
In May, Bloomberg's Jason Schreier reported that Bungie was planning significant staff cuts .
PlayStation acquired Bungie for $3.6 billion in 2022 but wrote down the purchase price by $765 million during its 2025/26 financial year. That's 21% of the value of the deal.
In 2023, it was reported that Sony would take full control of Bungie if the studio did not hit financial targets set after its acquisition .

title: Epic's Sweeney claims Steam AI labels are "really irresponsible of Valve"
author: Alex Forbes-Calvin
excerpt:
The CEO of Epic Games, Tim Sweeney, has said that Valve's decision to have disclosure labels for projects on Steam that make use of AI is "really irresponsible".
Read more
text:
The CEO of Epic Games, Tim Sweeney, has said that Valve's decision to have disclosure labels for projects on Steam that make use of AI is "really irresponsible".
Speaking to PC Gamer , the Fortnite chief said that this decision makes life harder for developers, arguing that AI is a way for creators to make unique assets comparable with asset stores or photoscanning. Sweeney continued, saying that the real value isn't in creating the perfect asset, but rather in the game, narrative and gameplay around those objects.
"It's unfortunate we're in this situation. It's unfortunate that so many developers now are put into this position. If you want to launch a game, and get it as widely publicized as possible, you've got to put it on Steam so people can wishlist it, and if you want to play it on Steam, then you have to get this Scarlet Letter of AI attached to your product, and now there is a hater community trying to kill the game," Sweeney said.
"I think it's really irresponsible of Valve. They shouldn't do it, because it makes it much, much, much harder for a game developer to have a chance of success. You have to choose from either not using tools that can make you way more productive, and probably failing due to competition that does."
Sweeney also discussed the loud public opposition to the use of AI in game development. The Epic boss said that the issue is "not a PR question", but rather one of "adoption of tools".
"There's nothing like a prompt-to-game solution on the horizon that anybody expects will work. All we have right now is the acceleration of programming using these coding assistant tools," Sweeney said. "They make programmers more productive for a lot of things—like it's a lot better. Instead of spending an hour hunting down a bug, Claude Code might spend an hour hunting it down for you, then you spend five minutes fixing it."
Pressed on AI use being a PR problem – that the case has not successfully been made to consumers – Sweeney said that it's "impossible" to "reconcile the idea" that developers shouldn't use AI – which he frames as "productivity-improving tools" – with the current state of the market.
"We've got to find greater means of efficiency," he said.
"It's unfortunate that so many of the AI companies operating early on had such shitty practices, you know, like one of them was found by a court to have gone off to a BitTorrent site and downloaded terabytes of data, that's ridiculous, they shouldn't do that. But the industry is, over time, coming up with better practices, and you're seeing efforts to use thoroughly licensed content bases for future AI models."
Sweeney has been outspoken about the use of AI in the games industry, previously arguing that platforms should stop tagging games that make use of AI and that the use of AI in development should have no bearing on how a game is received .
Recently, GamesIndustry.biz had a week of content about AI , covering topics including whether the technology was useful for coding and the use of AI in game development in general.

title: Italy's 34BigThings spins out from Embracer Group
author: Alex Forbes-Calvin
excerpt:
Italian studio 34BigThings has spun out of games conglomerate Embracer Group.
Read more
text:
Italian studio 34BigThings has spun out of games conglomerate Embracer Group.
Game Developer reports that the company's co-founder Valerio Di Donata has bought 100% of the studio's stock from the European giant. In doing so, 34BigThings is apparently the second-largest independent game developer in Italy.
The studio is best known for titles such as Carmageddon Rogue Shift and Redout.
"Returning to full independence gives us absolute autonomy to shape our structure, our projects, and our development approach. It's refreshing to be steering our own ship once more," Di Donata said.
"This new chapter will begin with an absolute bang. Later this year, we will be announcing a major title built on one of the most important, beloved, and revered intellectual properties in the world. And that's just the start: our production pipeline is fully charged, with another major title scheduled for 2027 followed by another groundbreaking project slated for 2028."
Embracer Group acquired 34BigThings back in 2020 during its seemingly-endless run of games purchases.
The studio now boasts over 70 members of staff and will be headed up by co-founder Giuseppe Enrico Franchi.
Since its huge line of purchases, the Embracer Group of today is a very different beast. The firm has split into three separate organisations: Asmodee Group, Coffee Stain Group and, finally, Fellowship Entertainment.
Former CEO Lars Wingefors said that the final spin-off, Fellowship Entertainment, represented "the most effective long-term solution" in a letter to shareholders .
"The main rationale to spin-off Fellowship is to increase management focus to capture the full joint potential of the IPs, their respective communities and some of the best game developers in the world," Wingefors wrote.
"Just like Asmodee and Coffee Stain, we believe Fellowship Entertainment will thrive the most by becoming its own standalone business."
